title: Best Dumbbells for Home Workouts in India (2026)
summary: Three fixed dumbbell picks for home workouts in India: a 3 kg pair, a 5 kg pair and a 7.5 kg single. Not hand-tested; based on shop pages.
description: Helps first-time home lifters in India pick fixed dumbbells. Compares a 3 kg pair, a 5 kg pair and a 7.5 kg single, based on shop pages.
lead: Which dumbbells should you buy for working out at home? This guide looks at three fixed-weight options on Decathlon India. One is a light 3 kg twin-pack for first-timers. One is a 5 kg twin-pack for the next step. One is a single 7.5 kg dumbbell for when you want more weight. We have not hand-tested any of them. We read the India shop pages, and we say clearly what those pages do not tell you.

picks.name: Domyos 3 kg Fitness Dumbbells Twin-Pack, Partially Recycled Cast Iron, Grey
picks.label: For first-timers
picks.verdict: A simple light pair with no setup. An easy place to start.
paragraphs: This is a fixed-weight pair from Domyos. The Decathlon India page calls it a 3 kg twin-pack. It lists the material as partially recycled cast iron. Fixed means the weight cannot be changed. You pick them up and use them. The page shows a 2 year warranty badge and a 30 day replacement badge.

Some things the page does not say. The heading says 3 kg with twin-pack, but it never says in words that each dumbbell is 3 kg. The page title tag reads 2*3Kg, which points to two dumbbells of 3 kg each. That title tag also says PVC, while the heading says cast iron. So the coating is unconfirmed. No size or handle details are listed. The page showed no sold-out message. Only the review count was shown, not review text. So we cannot say what buyers praise or complain about.
good: Light fixed weights suit people who are just starting out.
The page shows a 2 year warranty badge and a 30 day replacement badge.
The shop page shows about 4.8 out of 5 from about 2,300 buyers.
not_good: The page does not confirm any coating or the shape of the heads.
You get one weight per pair, so you must buy another pair to move up.
The page text does not say in words that 3 kg is per dumbbell. Only the title tag hints at it.

picks.name: Domyos 5 kg Fitness Dumbbells Twin-Pack, Partially Recycled Cast Iron, Black
picks.label: For the next step up
picks.verdict: A heavier fixed pair for when 3 kg starts to feel too easy. Best added after a lighter pair.
paragraphs: This is the 5 kg version of the same Domyos twin-pack line. The Decathlon India page lists the material as partially recycled cast iron. It shows a 2 year warranty badge and a 30 day replacement badge.

As with the 3 kg pack, the page text does not say in words that 5 kg is per dumbbell. The page title tag reads 2*5Kg, which points to two dumbbells of 5 kg each. That title tag also mentions PVC, while the product heading says cast iron. So the coating is unconfirmed. No handle size, head shape or review text is shown. The page showed no sold-out message.
good: A sensible second weight to add after a lighter pair.
The shop page shows about 4.8 out of 5 from about 1,800 buyers.
A 2 year warranty badge and a 30 day replacement badge are shown on the page.
not_good: It may feel heavy if you are a complete beginner. Start lighter if unsure.
The page does not confirm any coating, handle size or head shape.
The page text does not say in words that 5 kg is per dumbbell.

picks.name: Corength 7.5 kg 80% Recycled Cast Iron Dumbbell
picks.label: For more weight later
picks.verdict: A single heavier dumbbell for when lighter weights feel easy. You would buy two for a pair.
paragraphs: This is a single dumbbell. The Decathlon India title says Cross Training and Weight Training 7.5 kg 80% Recycled Cast Iron Dumbbell. The brand shown on the page is Corength. The title is singular, so the 7.5 kg is most likely for one dumbbell, but the page does not say so in words. It shows a 2 year warranty badge and a 30 day replacement badge.

The page gives no coating, shape, handle or size details, and it does not say what comes in the pack. Decathlon India's dumbbell list shows this one under the Domyos name, so the brand label is not consistent. You likely need two for a pair, but the page does not say this outright. The page showed no sold-out message, and review text was not shown.
good: Gives more weight per dumbbell than the twin-packs.
The shop page shows about 4.8 out of 5 from about 500 buyers.

not_good: Likely sold one at a time, so a pair means buying two.

choose.heading: Start light and go up in small steps
choose.text: Pick a weight you can lift with control. Start light and move up slowly. This is general advice, not medical advice. If you are unsure, ask a qualified trainer.

choose.heading: Plan for more than one weight
choose.text: Most people end up wanting at least two weights. A lighter one suits smaller muscles, and a heavier one suits larger muscles.

choose.heading: Fixed or adjustable
choose.text: Fixed dumbbells need no setup, but you buy each weight separately. Adjustable sets cover a range in one box, but changing the weight takes longer. Decathlon India also lists adjustable sets, but those pages show only the total set weight, so we did not pick one.

choose.heading: Check one dumbbell or a pair
choose.text: Read the title and the pack contents. Check if the weight shown is per dumbbell or the total. Some Decathlon India pages do not spell this out, so look closely before you order.

choose.heading: Look at the material and coating
choose.text: Cast iron is common for fixed dumbbells. Some pages list a coating and some do not. Check what the page really says before you order.

choose.heading: Read the exact product page
choose.text: Listings can disagree. A page title tag can say something different from the product heading. A brand label can change between pages. Warranty and return terms can also differ by country, so check the India page.

faq.q: How heavy should my first dumbbells be?
faq.a: Pick a weight you can lift with control and move up slowly. Larger muscles usually handle more weight than smaller ones. This is general advice, not medical advice. Ask a qualified trainer if you are unsure.

faq.q: Should I buy fixed or adjustable dumbbells?
faq.a: Fixed ones are quick and need no setup, but you buy each weight separately. An adjustable set gives a range in one box, but changing the weight is slower.

faq.q: Is the 7.5 kg Corength listing one dumbbell or two?
faq.a: The title is singular, so it is likely one dumbbell. You would then buy two for a pair. The page does not say this outright, so check before you order.

faq.q: Do these come with a warranty?
faq.a: The Decathlon India pages show a 2 year warranty badge and a 30 day replacement badge. We did not read the full terms, so check the policy on the page.
